recall_projection: per item, the forced-tier run's Recall@k at the tier its evidence pages are routed to (the lowest when several)
selection: highest dev page-tier accuracy among candidates whose projected dev Recall@k is not below fixed by more than the band; ties: fewer pages below the expected tier, lower cost per page, closest to the current values
split_rule: dev and test fixtures by rag_eval.split.assign_split(fixture_id) (Phase 1 D-14); dev items are dev-split items on dev fixtures
